title: Training-loss replay and the 978-window selection audit
question: Do the original training objectives flatten at the recorded budget, and why were only 978 price windows used?
configuration: CPU replay of none+CNN~none~none on FED-PX-REL5-v1 and Llama-3.1-8B(frozen)+CNN(frozen)~Pool~Add on FED-PXTX-ALL-REL5-v2 minus two exclusions; original budgets plus exactly ten updates, same cached features and optimization. No test scoring.
finding: The text-head full-training Smooth L1 fell 10.33% over ten extra updates, while validation MAE20 rose from 25.0641 to 26.1795 bp. The price extension increased training loss by 1.71%. The original price loader selected 978 announcement windows despite 225,561 training-period price bars.
limitations: CPU replay, not original W&B history or exact optimizer-state resume; original CUDA validation traces are reproduced within 0.000417 bp. Ten extra updates cannot certify convergence or generalization. The original selected checkpoints were preserved.

figure.alt: Full-training and validation Smooth L1 during CPU replays, and ten-update extension close-ups.
